goals.title: Offene kosmologische Fragen quellenkritisch einordnen
goals.neighborAssessment: c52d55c3 still supplies qualitative hot-Big-Bang reasoning from redshift and background radiation; d2e6f87d still supplies extraction and appraisal of physical source information. Its jurisdiction cache expanded from HE/BW/BY/RP to all states, but its meaning, direct requires and applicabilityMappingInheritance=boundary remain. Broader metadata does not reintroduce the former broad dark-matter/dark-energy knowledge requirement.
goals.oldReviewAssessment: Both complete records treat problem description, a testable question and a source judgement as one coherent inquiry into a supplied claim. Neither demands a complete catalogue of current cosmological problems or new research. Both preserve uncertainty and model-dependence and explicitly disclaim independent full source/projection verification.
goals.positiveProfileAssessment: The current P050 body already corrects the earlier implicit prerequisite burden in dark-matter-source-transfer: observations, uncertainties and competing models are supplied in both languages. Its two independent cases test a discriminating follow-up observation and proportional confidence; they do not assess additional dark-matter or dark-energy mastery. Retain both cases, all required expectations and the historical dissent.

sourceChecks.finding: The passage joins open cosmological problems, physical investigability and critical reading. Its partial one-to-many mapping explicitly rejects deriving universal knowledge of every dark component from the open choice of topic. This supports the bounded current competency.

The existing mapping is expressly partial: current cosmological research in an elective unit supports topical relevance, but does not literally prescribe all source-critique actions or all dark-matter/dark-energy content. That limit remains.

projectionAssessment.finding: The native atlas retains the exact D050 SekII tuples for GK/LK. No new target scope follows from the prerequisite-cache repair.

visualizationAssessment.finding: The existing image links example open questions to data, source, method, uncertainty and limits, and contrasts a sensational headline with evidence. Its examples remain orientation, not extra mandatory topic coverage. Current AI approval is bound to this hash; humanApproved remains no.

goals.rationaleDe: Der gespeicherte Geltungsbereich der qualitativen Urknall-Voraussetzung wurde berichtigt, ohne diese Kompetenz oder den eigenen Zielumfang zu erweitern. Beide alten KEEP-Begründungen und der bereits materialgestützte P050-Transfer bleiben fachlich passend. Die eigenen Quellenteilbezüge und sichtbaren Projektionstupel sind unverändert; keine Text-, Profil- oder Bildkorrektur ist durch diesen Nachbarwechsel begründet.
goals.rationaleEn: The stored applicability of the qualitative Big-Bang prerequisite was corrected without enlarging that competency or this target. Both existing KEEP rationales and the already material-supported P050 transfer remain appropriate. The target's bounded source links and visible projection tuples are unchanged; this neighbor change warrants no text, profile or image correction.

goals.title: Massen aus astronomischen Bahnbewegungen abschätzen
goals.neighborAssessment: 1b060e79 still describes galaxies and locates stellar systems in them; the former size/age bundle is absent. Its HE/BW/BY/RP/SL cache expanded through applicability closure, with its source-inheritance boundary intact. The unchanged qualitative relativity goal 14d99a65 supplies black-hole/event-horizon context. The dependent goal itself teaches the justified Newtonian inference; it does not rely on qualitative relativity to supply an unspoken quantitative derivation. c53b3f0c remains the separate successor for a dark-matter inference from discrepancy with visible matter.
goals.oldReviewAssessment: Both records identify one conditional dynamical inference, not separate black-hole and galaxy skills. Both distinguish enclosed mass from total mass or mass assigned solely to a black hole, require a suitable circular/symmetric or central-dominance approximation, and reject treating a disk as exactly spherical.
goals.positiveProfileAssessment: The P050 body already requires and explains v²/r = GM(<r)/r². Its independent central-orbit and extended-galaxy cases include supplied corrected radii/speeds, uncertainty, explicit system boundaries and interpretation limits. Multiple radii distinguish constant central mass from M(<r) increasing with r. The second case does not require discovery or identification of a dark-matter particle. Retain the three required expectations and both demonstrations.

sourceChecks.finding: The retained source explicitly connects gravitational-law mass estimates for the Milky Way and its central black hole with rotation-curve reasoning. The current partial one-to-many mapping keeps quantitative mass inference and the separate dark-matter interpretation and excludes the former size/age goal. It does not make this target a full quantitative theory of arbitrary galaxy geometry.

projectionAssessment.finding: The native atlas retains the exact D050 SekII tuples for GK/LK and the galactic-masses branch. Broader predecessor cache metadata does not broaden this target's projection.

visualizationAssessment.finding: The actual current QA row satisfies the native deliberate-deferral branch exactly. Both old D050 records also state that no image was bound. This is ready under the existing five-gate contract, not image approval or a requirement to generate a replacement in this adjudication.

goals.rationaleDe: Die Voraussetzung vermittelt weiterhin die Einordnung kosmischer Strukturen; die Masseninferenz wird im eigenen Ziel und Profil ausdrücklich als bedingtes Modell erarbeitet. Ihre Begründung, Unsicherheiten und Systemgrenzen bleiben erhalten. Der Nachbar-Cache trägt keine neue Fachanforderung hinein, und die bestehende Bildzurückstellung ist nach dem tatsächlichen Gate kein zusätzlicher Sperrgrund.
goals.rationaleEn: The prerequisite still supplies cosmic-structure context, while the target and profile explicitly develop mass inference as a conditional model. Its justification, uncertainty and system boundaries remain intact. The neighbor cache adds no subject requirement, and the existing image deferral is not an additional blocker under the actual gate.

goals.title: α-Zerfall durch Tunneleffekt
goals.neighborAssessment: 7d78da7f still qualitatively explains energy release from the rest-mass difference for alpha decay and simple reactions. Its earlier BY/MV/ST cache was broadened through requires-closure, without adding reaction calculations or fission/fusion/plant requirements. 51bc5513 still supplies qualitative wave-function probability density and detection probability. These remain sufficient conceptual inputs for the target's qualitative barrier explanation.
goals.oldReviewAssessment: Both KEEP records identify the same single explanatory competency: finite escape probability below a barrier while energy remains conserved. Their transfer compares controlled barrier widths and rejects borrowed energy, hidden classical paths and a certain individual decay time. Neither asks for lifetime formulas or quantitative tunneling calculations.
goals.positiveProfileAssessment: The complete P054 body uses an explicitly energetically allowed alpha model and a second controlled comparison at 4 versus 6 MeV. Barrier shape, preformation probability and encounter frequency are held fixed, so the qualitative rate direction is conditional rather than a universal nuclear law. Its two demonstrations do not covertly restore the removed broad nuclear-physics package. Preserve the historical predecessor-image dissent and its separately recorded resolution.

sourceChecks.finding: A direct exact source-extraction mapping exists for alpha decay through tunneling. The old HE legacy mapping d2e00a16-f794-47c1-9c0a-8501e8ac1d3d also remains, but is not needed as a substitute for this direct passage. The passage's LK label is not a new source approval for every compiled GK tuple.

projectionAssessment.finding: Current atlas scope is exactly the preexisting D050 scope. In particular, the broadened prerequisite cache does not add a BY target for alpha tunneling. Existing source/projection course-level distinctions remain existing coverage questions, not a change caused by this cache repair.

visualizationAssessment.finding: The current image shows U(r), a constant Ealpha, both turning points, the classically forbidden interval and explicit energy conservation. It does not show the rejected predecessor's oscillating barrier curve. Its existing separate AI approval matches this hash; the old dissent refers to a different preserved hash.

goals.rationaleDe: Die erweiterten Geltungsbereichsmetadaten der Energie-Voraussetzung verändern weder die qualitative Energiebilanz noch die Wahrscheinlichkeitsdeutung. Beide KEEP-Records und die kontrollierten P054-Modellfälle passen unverändert. Der direkte HE-LK-Quellenaspekt ist vorhanden; weder sein Umfang noch die eigenen Projektionstupel wurden erweitert. Das korrigierte Bestandsbild bleibt erhalten.
goals.rationaleEn: Expanded applicability metadata for the energy prerequisite changes neither qualitative energy accounting nor probability interpretation. Both KEEP records and the controlled P054 model cases still fit. The direct HE-LK source aspect exists, while neither its scope nor this target's projection tuples have been enlarged. Retain the corrected existing image.

goals.title: Kernreaktionen und Q-Werte
goals.neighborAssessment: 50877233 still supplies qualitative comparison of initial nuclei, products and conditions for fission/fusion; its cache gained BY. 7d78da7f still supplies qualitative rest-mass/energy accounting and gained the remaining jurisdictions through closure. Their meanings and the target's direct requires are unchanged. Quantitative Q accounting is the learning content of this goal, so qualitative prerequisites do not remove or presuppose that content.
goals.oldReviewAssessment: Both records explicitly justify the unified reaction-accounting process: A/Z conservation identifies the particles whose complete, consistently defined masses enter the energy balance. Both require the Q sign and a changed reverse-reaction case, not mere substitution. They retain the distinction between an energy balance and whether a reaction will occur.
goals.positiveProfileAssessment: The current P051 body gives three independent cases: nitrogen/alpha transmutation, deuterium/tritium forward and reverse reactions, and a negative-Q threshold overclaim. It requires consistent atomic/nuclear masses, electron accounting where necessary, signs and units. The threshold boundary asks only why Q alone does not fix laboratory projectile threshold, without a new threshold formula or experimental procedure. This protects the required energy interpretation and does not restore a removed broad nuclear competence. Keep all four required expectations and three demonstrations.

sourceChecks.finding: Current partial one-to-many mappings retain quantitative energy-balance clauses for selected nuclear reactions and the relevant conservation/model clauses. The 2026-09-08 mapping decisions explicitly keep the quantitative binding-energy and Q goals instead of redundant qualitative/safety-cluster coverage. This target is not asserted to cover every part of these wider source rows alone.

An unchanged exact legacy HE mapping exists. No direct Q-target row appears in the inspected current HE source-extraction review. The legacy link is retained as provenance, not relabeled as fresh direct normative verification. Unlike a new source adjudication, reusing these bounded description judgments adds no HE applicability claim.

projectionAssessment.finding: The current exact D050 SekII tuples remain. The HE SekII view moved the qualitative prerequisite entries into a foundations folder while leaving this target's existing reference intact. Such placement changes do not alter the Q evidence or convert requires-closure into source evidence.

visualizationAssessment.finding: The retained image illustrates one exoergic Q>0 case with m_before greater than m_after and Q=(m_before-m_after)c². Decorative nuclei are not a countable isotope equation. The current text and profile expressly retain negative Q and the reverse direction; no universal positive-Q assertion is introduced. Existing AI approval remains hash-bound, without human approval.

goals.rationaleDe: Die beiden Vorgänger behalten ihre qualitativen Rollen, während dieses Ziel ausdrücklich die vollständige quantitative Reaktionsbilanz vermittelt. Die BY-Quellenzuordnung hält diese Trennung bereits fest. Die Profilfälle prüfen Ladung, Nukleonenzahl, konsistente Massen und Vorzeichen zusammenhängend und begrenzen den Schluss auf eine Projektilschwelle. Aus den Cache-Erweiterungen folgt kein Bedarf, Zieltext, Evidenzkörper oder gutes Bestandsbild zu ändern.
goals.rationaleEn: Both predecessors retain their qualitative roles while this target explicitly teaches complete quantitative reaction accounting. The BY mappings already preserve that distinction. The profile cases coherently test charge, nucleon number, consistent masses and signs, while limiting any inference about projectile threshold. The cache expansions create no reason to change the target text, evidence body or good existing image.
